summary.intent: Initialize a CLAUDE.md for the entire-io-power-platform-samples repo, then implement a Dataverse plugin that validates account name and sets account number prefix on pre-create.
summary.outcome: CLAUDE.md was created, and AccountPreCreatePlugin.cs plus EntireSamples.Plugins.csproj were written, built cleanly, and committed. The Entire CLI was also authenticated and enabled for the repo.

repo: The repo is a multi-technology monorepo under src/ with each subfolder being a self-contained sample (plugins use .NET 4.6.2, PCF uses Node, Azure Functions use .NET isolated, etc.).
Dataverse plugins follow IPlugin interface, target net462, reference Microsoft.CrmSdk.CoreAssemblies 9.0.2.49.
Plugin registration metadata (entity, message, stage, mode) is encoded as XML comments at the top of the plugin class file, not in a separate registration file.
The Entire CLI is enabled in this repo with claude-code and copilot-cli agents configured; entire enable is idempotent.
The src/plugins/ folder was empty at session start — the prior plugin and csproj had been deleted and existed only in git history (commit ee5dcd6).

code.finding: Plugin guards on message name, entity logical name, and pipeline stage before executing business logic; wraps unexpected exceptions with ITracingService output and rethrows as InvalidPluginExecutionException.
Targets net462 with Microsoft.CrmSdk.CoreAssemblies 9.0.2.49 — standard for Dataverse sandbox plugins.

workflow: Entire CLI authenticates via device-code flow at https://entire.io/cli/auth; token is stored in the OS keychain.
Scoop is used to install/manage the Entire CLI: scoop bucket add entire https://github.com/entireio/scoop-bucket.git.
Recovering deleted files from git history (git show <sha>:<path>) is a reliable pattern when the working tree is empty but history exists.
CRLF warnings from git add on Windows are cosmetic and can be ignored for this repo.

friction: src/plugins/ was empty with no explanation — required git log archaeology to find the prior implementation before writing the new plugin.
entire login is an interactive blocking command; it required waiting for browser auth and a background task notification before confirming success.
find and ls commands had path quoting issues on Windows requiring multiple retries before getting a clean directory listing.
open_items: The commit modified docs/DOTNET-SKILLS.md, docs/prompt-samples/plugin-prompt.md, and terraform/README.md — these files were not discussed in the session and their changes are unreviewed.
No unit tests were written for AccountPreCreatePlugin.cs; test project scaffolding (if any) was not explored.
Other available Entire agents (codex, cursor, gemini, opencode, etc.) were listed but not evaluated or enabled.
